operations.name: John Loll

expected.charges: Destruction of government property, mutilation of records, interfering with the Selective Service System, and conspiracy (the May 25, 1969 Chicago draft-record burning).
expected.convicted: No verified conviction — failed to appear and case severed May 5, 1970
expected.sentence: No sentence verified. The case was severed when the defendant did not appear for trial.

updates.indicted: Indicted June 3, 1969 in the Chicago draft-record prosecution. His case was severed May 5, 1970 after he did not appear for trial.

operations.source: United States v. Chase, 468 F.2d 141 (7th Cir. 1972), footnote 1: https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/468/141/284039/
